label: LightONKaroo
description: Manual ANT+ and Bluetooth bike light control for Hammerhead Karoo 3 with Software Threat Mode, G-Brake Light, Speed-Adaptive Lighting, and iGPSPORT smart light support.
releaseNotes:
* Karoo OS 1.669.2569.20 Compatibility Fix: Integrated local write-only Parcelable stand-ins (HammerheadDeviceParcel & LightMode) inspired by szaffarano/karoofirefly PR #51 to bypass SELinux package read restrictions (kos_app_file) and restore ANT+ light control IPC transactions with SensorService
* Real-Time Data Field Status Indicators: Real-time G-BRAKE deceleration indicator (in Karoo Red #E52E2E) and dynamic SECONDARY speed-adaptive lighting status text
* Factory Reset Section: Dedicated Factory Reset card with rounded corners in Karoo Red (#E52E2E) that clears saved JSON preferences and UI cards, re-binds saved ANT+ lights, and triggers a fresh BLE scan
* Pure English UI: Standardized all UI labels and settings to clean English
